description: This file declares functions and structures related to URL processing, including URL validation, decoding, and manipulation functions.

methods.name: is_url
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid URL.

methods.name: is_urlschemechar
methods.description: Determines if a character is valid within a URL scheme component.

methods.name: url_decode_mem
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string with specified length.

methods.name: url_percent_decode
methods.description: Decodes %-encoded sequences found before any ':' in the URL.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_name
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded parameter names from query strings.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_value
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded parameter values from query strings.

methods.name: end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Appends a slash to the URL stored in a strbuf.

methods.name: str_end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Creates a new string with a slash appended to the given URL.
